第三章 化身剑兵
郭飞站起身，走下去推开了剑兵堂的门，光影组成的门一闪，里面的情景展现在眼前。
一个甬道，两侧各有一百个高三米、宽一米的空间格子，每个格子中都悬浮着一把黯淡无光、略有轮廓黑色的光影剑，看起来很是诡异。
郭飞心中一动，手掌朝其中一个光影剑一招，光影剑瞬间一闪，飞入了郭飞的身体内。
陡然间，如同一根尖刺，刺入了身体内，体内一股热流，如同刀子在体内乱窜，剧烈的疼痛让郭飞神识瞬间回到了本体，全身颤抖不已。
正在舞剑的老者陡然停止了舞剑，看着郭飞颤抖的身体一怔，轻声暗呼一声，身体一闪，瞬间到了郭飞面前。
郭飞承受不了剧烈的疼痛，心中想着要把这股热流驱逐出去，在心思一动间，光影剑心随意动的回到了兵符中，身体刺痛瞬间消失。
此时，老者已经扑到近前，抓起了郭飞的手，仔细查看了一下，面露不解之色。
“经脉略有伤损，不重，修养几天就好。经脉比刚才宽阔了很多，好处很大。真是奇怪！怎么好像有一股金气入体，暗自滋生一样，难道感觉出错了？”文叔看着郭飞，暗自思忖。
“怎么会这样，不知道咋回事，只是觉得一股气流冲入了身体内，接着消失了。”郭飞自然不能说实话，看着文叔询问的眼神，撒谎道。
文叔露出了迷茫之色，朝四周看了看，皱着眉头走到了一边坐了下去。
郭飞如同虚脱一样的躺在了干草上，他琢磨了良久，发现，在刚才那股气流入体的瞬间，给自己带来了力量，只是自己的体格太差，接纳不了这股气流。
同时，还有一种异样的感觉，在那一瞬间，似乎对剑无比的亲切，无比的熟悉，自己就是久经战事，久经杀伐的剑士，心中有把无形的剑在涌动。
“原来如此！”郭飞琢磨良久，略有所悟，兵符空间中的二百个黑色光影剑，正是代表每一个剑兵，光影剑入体，成为具有游戏属性的剑兵。
既然能成为剑兵，恐怕不能带来武将的技能了。兵符发生了异变，让郭飞彻底迷糊。但，他知道，加强身体锻炼，将这股剑气纳入体内，才是开启未知的第一步。
至于通过兵符回到地球，丝毫没有发现端倪，恐怕是白日做梦了。
北原，是浩渺大陆最北的广大区域，一年中有十个月冰雪覆盖着整个大地，气温最低的时候在零下百度。
皑皑白雪、冰封万里，一滴水滴在外面瞬间就能变成冰晶。
此时，在打铁作坊中，火红的炉火升腾着，旁边一个身高一米八，黑发遮耳、浓眉大眼、皮肤黑红的壮硕青年正在挥动着百十斤的大锤，准确的打击着钢锻，锤炼着兵刃。
大锤似乎正按照一定的节奏挥动，力量运转的恰到好处，一上一下如同飘逸的蝴蝶，星星点点的火花飘散，带动着长发随风舞动。

此人正是郭飞，转眼间过去了半年，郭飞刚开始的时候挥动大锤不足十下就气喘吁吁、腰酸腿疼。但他坚持下来了，其中的痛苦只有他自己知道，那是对生命的渴望，对活下去的坚持，才促使他有了强大的韧劲。
半年时间，郭飞和老者相依为命，郭飞虽然对这个世界不了解，但知道老者绝非普通人。打铁是个技术活，老者指点郭飞如何用力、如何使锤，如何炼体。
并传授了郭飞一套吐纳之法，在其帮助下，郭飞的身体渐渐强健了起来，如刀子一样的寒风，吹在肌肤上，感不到丝毫的痛楚。
这个世界很奇异，空气中蕴含着一股莫名的能量，在老者吐纳之法的帮助下，郭飞身体长高了不少，发生了很大的变化，刀削一样坚毅的脸庞略带一丝书生气，身体匀称和谐，虽然还透出稚嫩，但很英武。
最近一个月来，老者已经不动手了，武器的修补全部由郭飞来承担。这段时间，兵营每天都经历战事，损坏的武器不少。郭飞通过送兵器的小兵侧面了解，才知道，每年最冷的季节，正是鬼族猖獗的时候，天短夜长，鬼族不惧怕寒冷，正是他们占据天时的时候。
漫天飞雪遮蔽了整个苍穹，老者又开始在院落中央舞剑，这是他每天的习惯，一模一样的招式舞动三次，一次比一次快。
郭飞天天晚上观看，早就烂熟于心。
“如今这身体，是否能承受剑影入体！”郭飞思忖着，决定再试一试。
一道意念直通兵符中，光影剑瞬间一闪，投入了身体内。一股热流流转全身，经脉处微微作疼，但并不强烈，完全可以忍受。
“郭飞，一级剑兵。”在剑影入体的瞬间，脑海中出现了一组信息。果然，正是游戏里面剑兵的特性。
老者传授的吐纳之法自动运转，瞬间将这股热流牵引着流到了全身各处。此时，郭飞感到自己的力量瞬间增加了两倍，感觉顿时敏锐了起来。
老者舞动的剑，在郭飞眼中似乎变的和以前不一样了，这种感觉说不出来，郭飞看出了老者舞动剑招的痕迹，越看越觉得惊心。
原来就如同雾中看山，不见峥嵘山石，现在似乎云开雾散，看出了险滩幽谷、美景如画。
顺手一招，一柄刚修复好的剑竟然从地上瞬间窜入了郭飞的手中，郭飞茫然未觉，心神全部沉入了剑中，脚步移动，步入院落中，开始随着老者舞动。
风助雪势，雪舞苍穹，将两人的身影卷在飞雪中，渐渐的，风雪似乎受到牵引一样，随着两人的剑花飞舞，团团雪花变成了两条雪龙在院落中央盘旋。
“以体御剑、以意控体，剑随体动、体随意动、剑体合一；以法引气，化气为力，以力御剑，循环往复、生生不息！”老者舞剑的同时，口中念念有词，指点郭飞道。
郭飞按照老者的指点，运转老者传授的吐纳之法引动体内剑影气流，在全身流动，剑势如虹，渐渐的如同自己的手臂一样如臂役使了。
“好小子，想不到你竟然是练武的天才，短短时日，竟然触摸到了剑体合一的境界。”郭飞停下剑后，老者激动道。
“还是文叔指点有方！呵呵。”郭飞自然不能说出真相，是他借助光影剑入体，要是靠自己，估计没有十年八年的休想达到这个水平，十多年来最常打交道的就是笔和键盘，从来没有接触过武器，但目前只好一笑而过，不能道出实情。
“嗯，不要骄傲，作为修士，入门难，进步更难。看你的体质，应该是金属性的，要不然不可能对剑如此亲切。不过，‘金气’的凝练，不是一蹴而就的。”老者的话让郭飞似懂非懂。

（新书，求推荐、
content_en:
Chapter 3 Transformation into a swordsman
Guo Fei stood up, walked down and opened the door of the Sword Soldier Hall. The door made of light and shadow flashed, and the scene inside was revealed before his eyes.
There is a corridor with a hundred spatial grids three meters high and one meter wide on both sides. In each grid is suspended a dull, slightly black light and shadow sword, which looks very strange.
Guo Fei's heart moved, and he struck one of the light and shadow swords with his palm. The light and shadow sword flashed instantly and flew into Guo Fei's body.
Suddenly, like a sharp thorn, it pierced into the body. A stream of heat surged through the body like a knife. The severe pain caused Guo Fei's consciousness to return to his body in an instant, and his whole body trembled.
The old man who was dancing with the sword suddenly stopped dancing. He was startled when he saw Guo Fei's trembling body. He let out a soft cry inwardly, flashed his body, and was in front of Guo Fei in an instant.
Guo Fei couldn't bear the severe pain, and thought about driving out the heat. In a flash of thought, the light and shadow sword heart returned to the weapon talisman at will, and the pain in his body disappeared instantly.
At this time, the old man had already rushed forward, grabbed Guo Fei's hand, and looked at it carefully, with a look of confusion on his face.
"The meridians are slightly damaged, but not serious. Just cultivate for a few days and it will be fine. The meridians are much wider than before, which is a great benefit. It's really strange! Why does it seem like a golden energy enters the body and secretly grows? Could it be that something is wrong?" Uncle Wen looked at Guo Fei and thought to himself.
"How could this happen? I don't know what happened. I just felt a stream of air rushing into my body and then disappeared." Naturally, Guo Fei couldn't tell the truth. Looking at Uncle Wen's questioning eyes, he lied.
Uncle Wen looked confused, looked around, frowned, walked to one side and sat down.
Guo Fei lay on the hay as if exhausted. He thought about it for a long time and found that the moment the air flowed into his body, it gave him strength, but his physique was too poor to accept this air flow.
At the same time, there was also a strange feeling. At that moment, it seemed that he was extremely kind and familiar with the sword. He was a swordsman who had experienced battles and killed many times, and there was an invisible sword surging in his heart.
"So that's it!" Guo Fei pondered for a long time and finally realized that the two hundred black light and shadow swords in the weapon space represent each sword soldier. The light and shadow sword enters the body and becomes a sword soldier with game attributes.
Since he can become a swordsman, I'm afraid he won't be able to bring the skills of a military commander. Something happened to the soldier talisman, which completely confused Guo Fei. However, he knew that strengthening his body and incorporating this sword energy into his body was the first step to unlocking the unknown.
As for returning to the earth through the military talisman, no clues were found. I'm afraid it's just a daydream.
Beiyuan is the northernmost vast area of ​​the vast continent. The entire land is covered with ice and snow for ten months a year, and the lowest temperature is 100 degrees below zero.
It is covered with snow and ice for thousands of miles, and a drop of water can turn into ice crystals in an instant when outside.
At this time, in the blacksmith's workshop, the red fire was rising. Next to him, a sturdy young man with a height of 1.8 meters, black hair covering his ears, thick eyebrows and big eyes, and dark red skin was swinging a 100-pound sledgehammer, hitting the steel forge accurately and tempering the weapon.
The sledgehammer seemed to be swinging according to a certain rhythm, and the power was moving just right. It moved up and down like an elegant butterfly, with little sparks floating around, causing the long hair to dance in the wind.
This person is Guo Fei. Half a year has passed in the blink of an eye. When Guo Fei first started swinging the sledgehammer less than ten times, he was out of breath, with backache and leg pain. But he persisted, and only he knew the pain. It was his desire for life and his insistence on living that gave him strong tenacity.
For half a year, Guo Fei and the old man depended on each other. Although Guo Fei didn't understand the world, he knew that the old man was by no means an ordinary person. Blacksmithing is a technical job, and the old man taught Guo Fei how to use force, how to use the hammer, and how to train his body.
and taught GuoWith the help of Fei's breathing method, Guo Fei's body gradually became stronger. The cold wind like a knife blew on his skin without feeling the slightest pain.
This world is very strange, and there is an inexplicable energy in the air. With the help of the old man's breathing method, Guo Fei's body has grown a lot, and has undergone great changes. His face is as strong as a knife with a hint of bookishness, and his body is well-proportioned and harmonious. Although he still looks young, he is very heroic.
In the past month, the old man has stopped doing anything, and Guo Feilai has been responsible for all the repairs of the weapons. During this period, the barracks experienced fighting every day, and many weapons were damaged. Guo Fei learned from the side of the soldier who delivered the weapons that the coldest season of the year is when the ghost tribe is rampant. The days are short and the nights are long. The ghost tribe is not afraid of the cold. It is the time when they occupy the sky.
The sky was covered with flying snow, and the old man began to dance his sword in the center of the courtyard again. This was his daily habit. He performed the same move three times, each time faster than the last.
Guo Fei watches it every night and has long been familiar with it.
"Can this body withstand the sword shadow now?" Guo Fei thought and decided to try again.
A thought went straight into the weapon talisman, and the light and shadow sword flashed into the body. A stream of heat flows through the whole body, and the meridians feel a slight pain, but it is not strong and is completely bearable.
"Guo Fei, a first-level swordsman." The moment the sword shadow entered his body, a set of information appeared in his mind. Sure enough, it is exactly the characteristics of the sword soldiers in the game.
The breathing method taught by the old man automatically operates, instantly drawing the heat flow to all parts of the body. At this time, Guo Fei felt that his strength had doubled in an instant, and his senses suddenly became sharper.
In Guo Fei's eyes, the sword that the old man was dancing seemed to be different from before. This feeling was indescribable. Guo Fei saw the traces of the old man's sword moves, and the more he looked at it, the more frightened he felt.
It used to be like looking at a mountain in the fog, without seeing the majestic rocks. Now it seems that the clouds have cleared and the fog has dispersed, and you can see the dangerous shoals, deep valleys and picturesque scenery.
With a smooth move, a newly repaired sword suddenly jumped from the ground into Guo Fei's hand. Guo Fei was at a loss and his mind sank into the sword. He moved his steps, stepped into the courtyard, and began to dance with the old man.
The wind helped the snow, and the snow danced in the sky, wrapping the two figures in the flying snow. Gradually, the wind and snow seemed to be pulled. As the two people's swords flew, the clusters of snowflakes turned into two snow dragons circling in the center of the courtyard.
"Use your body to control the sword, use your mind to control the body, the sword moves with the body, the body moves at will, and the sword and body are unified; use the law to guide the qi, turn the qi into force, use force to control the sword, the cycle goes back and forth, endless!" While dancing the sword, the old man muttered words and gave guidance to Guo Fei.
Guo Fei followed the old man's instructions and used the breathing method taught by the old man to activate the sword shadow air flow in his body, flowing throughout his body. The sword was like a rainbow, and gradually became as powerful as his own arm.
"Good boy, I didn't expect you to be a genius in martial arts. In just a short period of time, you actually touched the realm of sword and body integration." After Guo Fei stopped his sword, the old man said excitedly.
"Uncle Wen's advice is good! Haha." Naturally, Guo Fei couldn't tell the truth. He was the one who entered the body with the help of the Light and Shadow Sword. If he had relied on himself, he probably wouldn't have reached this level in ten or eight years. For more than ten years, he has mostly dealt with pens and keyboards, and has never touched weapons. But now he can only laugh it off and cannot tell the truth.
"Well, don't be proud. As a monk, it's hard to get started and even harder to make progress. Judging from your physique, it should be metallic, otherwise you wouldn't be so kind to the sword. However, the condensation of 'golden energy' is not achieved overnight." The old man's words made Guo Fei seem to understand.
